QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_61

question.text: Fund PQR peak AUM in Q1 2020 = Rs. 632.33 crore; trough = Rs. 545.61 crore. MDD ≈ ?

explanation.text: The Logic: MDD = (545.61 − 632.33)/632.33 = -13.71%. The Trap: -8.5%/+13.71% are incorrect; -38.78% is NIFTY50 MDD in the same period. Cross-Exam Context: Example 13 in workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Showcase fund MDD vs benchmark MDD — a MDD of -13.71% vs -38.78% reflects downside protection.
